user.title: 🪄 Connect your MyHOME Gateway
user.description:
🪄 **Zero-Knowledge Mode:** Your gateway is automatically discovered on your local network.

Toggle **NERD MODE 🤓** if you wish to manually configure IP address, port, MAC address, and model.
